associations.rationale: For q not of finite order, the formal type identifies the center subalgebra with bottom, but it does not itself state the absence of nontrivial two-sided ideals, so it covers only the center component.
For q not of finite order, the formal type asserts IsSimpleRing for the q-Weyl algebra, but it does not itself identify the center as scalar, so it covers only the ideal-simplicity component.
